title: Chess
short_description: A calm, classic game of 3D chess — hand-turned wooden pieces on a clean board, with a thoughtful AI across four skill levels.
description: Classic chess in clean 3D. A full ruleset — legal moves, check, checkmate, castling, en passant and promotion — with a proper Staunton set: turned ivory and ebony pieces (and a sculpted knight) that lift, glide and set down as you play. Face a tactical AI at four strengths (Novice to Grandmaster), orbit the board freely, or play a friend online. Unhurried and quiet — a board game, not a battle.
controls_keyboard: Left-click a piece to select · click a highlighted square to move · Right-drag rotate camera · scroll zoom · Esc pause · F3 debug
